items.text:
Really interesting game, but i cant recommend it yet. I bought to help the Dev, i quite liked NeoScavenger, but this game is in a very rough state.
I lost quite a few hours due to the game not saving for example. Or getting stuck on the space station. I am sure it will get ironed out, but so far it is not.
items.text_zh:
非常有趣的游戏，但我还不能推荐它。我买它是为了支持开发者，我挺喜欢NeoScavenger的，但这款游戏处于非常粗糙的状态。
例如，由于游戏不保存，我损失了好几个小时。或者卡在空间站上。我相信这些问题会被解决的，但到目前为止还没有。

observations.evidence: Or getting stuck on the space station.
